title: Select explicit sales order sources in the deposit application workflow
description: Stage3 explicit business source selection. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add bounded authorized sales-order candidate API for deposit-apply: live enabled identity, existing deposit-apply menu and existing sales-order source permission, current customer scope, exact customer and normalized currency, nondeleted eligible order state per FinanceDepositApplyLifecycleRules. Apply scope before counts/pagination and return only bounded safe DTO fields. Selection cannot bypass final locked authoritative create/update validation. Separate stored-source resolution preserves exact historical links with unavailable/status annotations, never returns foreign fields or guesses source from order number. No new permission grants, orders, currency conversion or balance claims.

Wire optional SalesOrderId selection into actual deposit-apply create/edit/detail UI using existing form hooks and the shared finance application source picker. Customer/currency changes invalidate selection, stale responses cannot restore a previous context, explicit unlink only on editable documents, no silent change to existing historical linkage or amount/rate. Reopen correctly displays stored source including cancelled/unavailable history; source selection never automatically changes money. Failed candidate/save preserves user form input and surfaces useful error. Real SQL API own/foreign/mismatched currency/cancelled/revoked/disabled plus final forged-ID denial; executable JS integration create/edit/reopen/change/stale/unlink/error tests, meaningful unit and safe Release verification. Browser evidence or accurate blocker.

implementation_evidence: Finance1.cs deposit application already persists nullable SalesOrderId and ERP381/380 validates it. modules-finance.js deposit-apply fields omit SalesOrderId, so actual users cannot select an explicit order. FinanceApplyControllers.cs has no bounded candidate route. Existing source pickers and ERP389 demonstrate form hooks; reuse a shared finance application source service and selector across both application types, no new schema.
